compiled_coordinate_audit.interpretation: Current componentwise plane residual changes under a pure target/world coordinate rotation and adds tangent stiffness (rank2 instead of rank1). This does not prove causality for map/tracking drift, runtime gain, or safety of altered fitness semantics.
